2607.14165.title: Towards Reliable AI-Assisted Analog Design: Template-Constrained LLM Agents for SAR ADC Generation
2607.14165.paper_summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant capability in software code generation, their application to analog Electronic Design Automation (EDA) is bottlenecked. Owing to limited circuit topology understanding and data, directly prompting LLMs and multimodal models leads to hallucinations and failure to produce schematics capable of passing rigorous SPICE simulations, as we show in our work. Instead, we propose an end-to-end, multi-step LLM agentic framework ATLAS, capable of generating a functional Successive Approximation Register (SAR) Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) that successfully passes simulation validation. To adhere to the rigid constraints of analog design, we utilize expert knowledge to ground the LLM in its planning, selection, parameterization, and iterative modification. As part of ATLAS, we introduce Template-Constrained Generation - which unlike other template-based works - builds towards a more generalized SAR ADC generation flow. We demonstrate a strong proof-of-concept of our framework by developing SAR ADCs across technology nodes and input specs. Overall, our expert-knowledge grounded multi-step agentic ATLAS establishes a pragmatic foundation for integrating LLMs into reliable analog design methodologies.
2607.14165.paper_summary_zh: 雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）在軟體程式碼生成方面展現了顯著的能力，但其在類比電子設計自動化（EDA）中的應用卻受到瓶頸。由於對電路拓撲的理解和數據有限，直接提示LLMs和多模態模型會導致幻覺並無法生成能夠通過嚴格SPICE模擬的原理圖，正如我們在工作中所展示的。相反，我們提出了一個端到端的多步驟LLM代理框架ATLAS，能夠生成一個功能性連續逼近寄存器（SAR）類比數位轉換器（ADC），並成功通過模擬驗證。為了遵循類比設計的嚴格約束，我們利用專家知識使LLM在其規劃、選擇、參數化和迭代修改中扎根。作為ATLAS的一部分，我們引入了模板約束生成——這與其他基於模板的工作不同——朝著更通用的SAR ADC生成流程發展。我們通過在不同技術節點和輸入規格下開發SAR ADC，展示了我們框架的強有力概念驗證。總體而言，我們基於專家知識的多步驟代理ATLAS為將LLMs整合進可靠的類比設計方法學建立了一個務實的基礎。
